summary: {reviewer} asks what a buyer can learn from the package without following a link to a clinical study.
realLife: Commenters proposed posting study summaries on a website. FDA kept the requirement to include summaries of supporting clinical studies in the inside labeling.
inGame: needs: label inserts and applicable clinical studies.

turns.pulledBy: The enclosed summary explains the test in ordinary language.
turns.what: The reviewer finds the study summary in the insert.
turns.writesBack: A buyer can ask whether those results cover the feature they want.

turns.pulledBy: The insert directs the reader only to a website.
turns.what: A reader looks through the insert and finds only a link.
turns.writesBack: The reviewer asks the manufacturer for the required summary.
